mainEntity.name: What is the acclimation process for hardwood flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Acclimation is a crucial step where hardwood planks are allowed to adjust to the temperature and humidity levels of your home before installation. This typically involves leaving the sealed wood bundles in the rooms where they will be installed for 3-7 days, sometimes longer depending on environmental conditions. This process minimizes the wood's expansion or contraction after installation, preventing issues like gapping, cupping, or warping. Proper acclimation is vital for the long-term stability and appearance of your new floors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Acclimation allows hardwood planks to adjust to your home's temperature and humidity before installation, typically for 3-7 days. This prevents future issues like gapping or warping, ensuring floor stability.
